mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.name AS name, u.email AS email, u.role AS role, u.created_at AS createdAt, CASE WHEN um.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN '멤버십' ELSE '일반' END AS membershipType, CASE WHEN cs.risk_level = 'HIGH' THEN '고위험' WHEN cs.risk_level = 'MID' THEN '중위험' ELSE '저위험' END AS riskLevel, COALESCE(cs.score, 0.0) AS churnProbability FROM users u LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM user_membership WHERE status IN ('ACTIVE', 'CANCELLED') ) um ON u.user_id = um.user_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (user_id) user_id, risk_level, score FROM churn_score ORDER BY user_id, scored_at DESC, churn_score_id DESC ) cs ON u.user_id = cs.user_id ORDER BY u.user_id DESC
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM user_membership WHERE status IN ('ACTIVE', 'CANCELLED')
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM user_membership WHERE status IN ('ACTIVE', 'CANCELLED') AND start_date >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT um.user_id) FROM user_membership um INNER JOIN churn_score cs ON um.user_id = cs.user_id WHERE um.status IN ('ACTIVE', 'CANCELLED') AND cs.risk_level = 'HIGH'

SELECT u.name AS name, um.end_date AS ends, COALESCE(cs.score, 0.0) AS score, '혜택 미사용 30일' AS reason, '만류 쿠폰' AS action, CASE WHEN um.status = 'ACTIVE' THEN '예정' ELSE '발송됨' END AS status FROM user_membership um INNER JOIN users u ON um.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (user_id) user_id, score FROM churn_score ORDER BY user_id, scored_at DESC, churn_score_id DESC ) cs ON um.user_id = cs.user_id WHERE um.status IN ('ACTIVE', 'CANCELLED') ORDER BY um.user_membership_id DESC

SELECT c.coupon_id AS couponId, c.name AS name, c.discount_type AS discountType, c.discount_value AS discountValue, c.end_date AS endDate, c.quantity AS quantity, COALESCE(uc.issued_count, 0) AS issuedCount, COALESCE(uc.used_count, 0) AS usedCount, CASE WHEN c.name LIKE '%이탈%' OR c.name LIKE '%만류%' THEN '위험고객' WHEN c.name LIKE '%유지%' OR c.name LIKE '%재구매%' THEN '멤버십 해지위험' WHEN c.name LIKE '%웰컴%' OR c.name LIKE '%가입%' THEN '신규' ELSE '일반' END AS targetGroup FROM coupons c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT coupon_id, COUNT(*) AS issued_count, SUM(CASE WHEN used = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS used_count FROM user_coupons GROUP BY coupon_id ) uc ON c.coupon_id = uc.coupon_id ORDER BY c.coupon_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO coupons (name, discount_type, discount_value, start_date, end_date, quantity) VALUES ( #{name}, #{discountType}, #{discountValue}, CAST(#{startDate} AS DATE), CAST(#{endDate} AS DATE), #{quantity} )
